meta.name: Chicago Marathon 2026
meta.description:
October 11, 2026. One of the most vibrant marathon courses in the United States, the Chicago marathon brings you on a lively tour of the city through notable neighbourhoods as well as some of the best restaurants, bakeries and cafes!

This is the race event course for the 2026 edition of the Chicago Marathon.

waypoints.Dialogue: Northalsted! One of the great marathon experiences. Chicago's historic LGBTQ+ neighborhood puts on an enormous party, with music, costumes, drag performers, rainbow flags, and incredible crowd energy.
Pilsen! A vibrant Mexican-American neighborhood known for colorful murals, mariachi music, and enthusiastic spectators.
Chinatown! The ornate Chinatown Gate, red lanterns, traditional lion dancers, drumming, and cheering spectators.
Just over 2 miles, back to here
